dbus 0.7.15 — covered source availability

Domabas uses the unmodified dbus 0.7.15 Dart package for Linux desktop
integration. Its covered source is available under the Mozilla Public License,
version 2.0 (MPL-2.0).

Download the complete, exact package source free of charge:
https://pub.dev/api/archives/dbus-0.7.15.tar.gz

Version information:
https://pub.dev/packages/dbus/versions/0.7.15

The download is a gzip-compressed tar archive. Extract it with an archive tool
(or run: tar -xzf dbus-0.7.15.tar.gz). It contains the original Dart source,
package metadata, tests, examples, copyright notices and the full MPL-2.0 text
in LICENSE. These source files remain under their original MPL-2.0 terms.

Archive SHA-256:
a48d5da28e89bd02196e80d81ed8d7954923d00a0f4a68cc20b575038f023383

The original LICENSE and this retrieval notice are retained in the Domabas
source distribution under third_party/licenses/sources/dbus/0.7.15/.
The source archive itself is available from the upstream download above.

This source notice concerns dbus only. It does not change the license of
separate Domabas application files or restrict your rights to the dbus source.
